turns.question: What share of all orders placed between 17 August and 2 October 2026 were cancelled?
turns.answer: The cancellation rate (share of orders cancelled) for orders placed from 17 August to 2 October 2026 inclusive was 0.0952, about 9.5 % of all orders. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
